## Home (`/`)
- **Headline:** Computer Science Student
- **Subtitle Summary:** MSc student in Computer Science & Engineering at **Instituto Superior Técnico**. Contributor and maintainer of **HtmlFlow**.
- **About Section:**
  - Lisbon-based computer science student finishing an MSc at Instituto Superior Técnico.
  - Holds a BSc degree from **Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa**.
  - Main interests are distributed systems and cybersecurity.
  - Maintainer of HtmlFlow (a Java/Kotlin DSL for type-safe HTML generation).
  - Recent Developer Apprentice at **Sky Portugal**: built a Lightning.js tool that streamlined deeplink QA across Peacock, SkyShowtime, NOW, and Showmax on LG and Samsung TVs.

## Experience, Education, & Skills (`/experience`)
### Experience
**Apprentice Developer** @ **Sky Portugal**  
*Jul 2025 - Aug 2025*
- Developed and delivered a Lightning.js-based testing tool that streamlined deeplink testing and improved QA testing speed.
- Implemented cross-platform and cross-device testing across Sky streaming products (Peacock, SkyShowtime, NOW, Showmax) for LG and Samsung devices.
- Improved front-end skills in an agile environment with version-control workflows.

   - **Grade:** 17/20
2. **BSc in Computer Science & Engineering**
   - **School:** Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa
   - **Grade:** 17/20
   - **Final Project:** Non-Blocking Progressive SSR Benchmark (Grade: 20/20). Benchmarked reactive, coroutine, and virtual-thread approaches to HTML rendering. Evaluated the viability of virtual threads for non-blocking progressive SSR with external DSL engines.

## Projects (`/projects`)
Things Bernardo has built or contributed to.

**P01 — HtmlFlow**
- **Tagline:** Java/Kotlin DSL for typesafe HTML generation
- **Description:** Maintainer of HtmlFlow. Type-safe HTML 5.2 templates in code with compile-time safety, synchronous and asynchronous rendering, and high JVM performance.
- **Stack:** Java, Kotlin
- **URL:** [https://github.com/xmlet/HtmlFlow](https://github.com/xmlet/HtmlFlow)

**P02 — Non-Blocking Progressive SSR Benchmark**
- **Tagline:** Benchmarking non-blocking PSSR techniques in Java
- **Description:** Benchmarked reactive programming, coroutines, and virtual threads in Java/Kotlin for non-blocking progressive SSR.
- **Stack:** Java, Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, JMeter
- **URL:** [https://github.com/xmlet/comparing-non-blocking-progressive-ssr](https://github.com/xmlet/comparing-non-blocking-progressive-ssr)

**P03 — Musyk**
- **Tagline:** A Discord bot for music playback
- **Description:** Feature-rich Discord bot for voice-channel music playback, supporting YouTube, Spotify, playlists, search, and playback controls.
- **Stack:** Node.js, TypeScript, Discord.js
- **URL:** [https://github.com/BernardoPe/musyk](https://github.com/BernardoPe/musyk)

**P04 — Depchain**
- **Tagline:** A simplified Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) blockchain
- **Description:** Simplified BFT blockchain with dependability guarantees for transaction execution and smart contract state management.
- **Stack:** Java, Solidity
- **URL:** [https://github.com/BernardoPe/depchain](https://github.com/BernardoPe/depchain)

**P05 — Instant Messaging**
- **Tagline:** Real-time instant messaging web application
- **Description:** Real-time messaging app using Server-Sent Events, typed Kotlin/Spring backend, React and Android clients.
- **Stack:** Kotlin, Spring, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, React, Docker, Android
- **URL:** [https://github.com/BernardoPe/instant-messaging](https://github.com/BernardoPe/instant-messaging)

**P06 — Personal Website**
- **Tagline:** This portfolio
- **Description:** Portfolio website built with React + TypeScript, styled with Tailwind, deployed on Cloudflare Workers.
- **Stack:** React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers
- **URL:** [https://github.com/BernardoPe/portfolio](https://github.com/BernardoPe/portfolio)

## Site Technical Platform
- **Framework:** Next.js 15 App Router + React 19
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4
- **Hosting/Runtime:** Cloudflare Workers (Static Export + Worker Agent)
- **AI Chat Source:** Cloudflare Agents API + `@cloudflare/ai-chat/react`
